summary: The gaia variant exhibits excellent architectural alignment with the provided Gaia methodology documentation, implementing all required agent roles and behaviors as skeletons. However, it lacks any functional implementation of the matching algorithms, rendering it a prototype rather than a working system.

findings.description: Perfect alignment with the Gaia Role Model (PropertyOwner, BusinessEntity, Resident, Marketplace).
findings.evidence: Agents in agents/ folder match the PDF documentation roles exactly.

findings.description: Matching logic (R1) is entirely missing; the behavior only prints a success message without processing data.
Hardcoded passwords used for agent JIDs in simulation.

missing_requirements: Functional matching logic based on price, size, and location (R1)
implementation_risks: System is non-functional for its primary purpose (pairing) until matching algorithms are implemented.
